content._comment: Hand-maintained list of players CONFIRMED out for the full season. This is the ONLY thing that zeroes a projection. It is deliberately manual: Sleeper's IR flag means 'unavailable now', not 'done for the year' — NFL rules permit return from injured reserve and designated-to-return is routine, so automating IR -> 0 would print false zeros on players who come back. Sleeper's status still drives a visible IR/PUP badge automatically; that is display only. Effects of an entry here: projected PPG goes to 0, an OUT tag appears, and the player is excluded from the accuracy-ledger graded set (a near-zero projection on a player everyone knows is out is not a prediction the model made). Model value is deliberately NOT touched — the market prices the absence. Since 8 Oct 2026 the DELTA Score's production axis counts this season as missed straight away (the same rule the offseason roll would apply), for players who played last season; see dsProductionNow in delta-engine.js. See docs/ACCURACY-LEDGER.md section 6. Keys beginning with underscore are ignored. Remove an entry once the player is active again.
